0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-6, 12th in the East, losers of three straight) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-8, 15th in the West, losers of two straight) in Orlando's 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with the Magic 2-2 on the road and the Kings 0-4 at home. Orlando is missing Desmond Bane (illness), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and Orlando won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 121-117 win in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
